name: A10-0235/2026 – Christophe Grudler – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion of a broad package of agreements to consolidate, deepen and expand the bilateral relations with the Swiss Confederation
part_text:
The European Parliament's foreign affairs committee recommends that Parliament approve a new set of agreements between the EU and Switzerland. The package updates old deals on free movement of people, transport, trade in farm products and product testing, and adds new ones on electricity, health, food safety and Swiss participation in EU programmes like research and student exchange. It also sets up a permanent Swiss payment towards poorer EU regions and a joint parliamentary committee. The report is an opinion and recommendation; the final decision on approval is taken later.

- **What changes:** Updated and new EU–Switzerland deals on travel, trade, energy, health, research and food safety.
- **Who it affects:** Workers, students, researchers, businesses and border regions in the EU and Switzerland.
- **What happens next:** Parliament votes on giving its consent; Switzerland then runs its own approval process.
